title: The Orion Observatory
victim: Professor Leon Walter, director of the observatory
teaser: A snowstorm cut off the road down the mountain, and the night shift is stuck at the summit. The professor lies by the telescope, the dome is shut, and the observation log has no entry for the last hour. Someone erased it and pretended to have been watching the sky all night.

habits.label: Frostbitten cheeks
habits.habit: White frostbite patches on the cheekbones
clues: A tin of goose fat, used on frostbitten skin, has been opened in the dining room first-aid kit. The culprit has frostbitten cheeks.
During the night the cook saw a face with waxy white patches on the cheekbones in the dining room. The culprit has frostbite marks on their cheeks.

habits.label: Fur boots
clues: The steps up to the summit show wide heelless prints, like fur boots. The culprit wears fur boots.
There are tufts of reindeer fur and puddles of melted snow on the iron floor of the dome. The culprit goes about in fur boots.

habits.label: Edelweiss badge
habits.habit: An edelweiss badge on the pocket
clues: An enamel edelweiss badge with a bent pin lies on the dome floor by the telescope. The culprit wears an edelweiss badge.
The graduate student remembers a silver edelweiss glinting on a pocket in the torchlight. The culprit wears an edelweiss badge.

habits.label: Smells of pine
habits.habit: Smells of pine needles and resin
clues: The closed dome smells of pine resin, and trees only grow at the foot of the mountain. The culprit smells of pine.
There's a sticky drop of resin with fir needles on the stairs to the summit. The culprit smells of pine and resin.

habits.label: Black beret
habits.habit: A black beret worn at an angle
clues: The wind has pinned a black beret to the railing on the stairs to the summit. The culprit wears a beret.
Through the slit in the dome the graduate student made out a silhouette with a beret worn at an angle. The culprit wears a black beret.

habits.label: Scar on the chin
habits.habit: A white scar across the chin
clues: In the glow of the generator-room lamp the radio operator saw a face with a white line across the chin. The culprit has a scar on their chin.
On a group photo of an expedition in the library, one face with a scar on the chin has been circled in pencil. The culprit has a scar on their chin.

habits.label: Does sums in their head
habits.habit: Calculates faster than an adding machine
clues: The margins of the observation log hold long calculations without a single intermediate step. The culprit does sums in their head.
The adding machine in the lab is still under its cover, yet the table of corrections was finished overnight. The culprit does sums in their head.

habits.label: Hard of hearing
clues: The lab assistant called out to a shadow on the stairs, and it only turned on the third call, right side first. The culprit is deaf in one ear.
The radio in one guest room is turned up full, and the neighbours complain about it every night. The culprit is hard of hearing.

habits.label: Compass on a cord
habits.habit: A compass on a leather cord
clues: A pocket compass with a broken cord lies under the telescope. The culprit wears a compass on a cord.
In the snow on the stairs to the summit there's a loop of leather cord with a compass's brass ring. The culprit wears a compass on a cord.

habits.label: Knits
clues: A long grey wool thread is wound around a gear of the dome drive, as if it ran from a ball in someone's pocket. The culprit knits.
A ball of grey wool with a needle stuck through it is hidden behind an armchair in the library. The culprit knits.

habits.label: Developer stains
clues: The dome door handle has brown stains on it, the kind photographic developer leaves. The culprit has developer stains on their fingers.
The plate from the last hour was developed in the lab overnight, and the tray has brown fingerprints on it. The culprit has developer-stained fingers.

habits.label: Flask of cognac
habits.habit: A flask of cognac in the inside pocket
clues: A flask stopper that smells of cognac lies on the floor by the telescope. The culprit carries a flask of cognac.
A page of the observation log has a sticky ring from a flask and smells of cognac. The culprit carries a flask of cognac.

habits.label: Southern accent
clues: The caretaker heard a voice with a slow southern drawl behind the dome door. The culprit has a southern accent.
Someone on the stairs to the summit shouted "Hold up, y'hear!", the way only southerners talk. The culprit speaks with a southern accent.

habits.label: Crooked finger
habits.habit: A middle finger that healed crooked
clues: The frosted library window has a handprint with a bent middle finger. The culprit has a crooked finger.
The railing of the dome's spiral staircase bears a handprint where one finger healed crooked after a break. The culprit has a crooked finger.

habits.label: Writes poetry
habits.habit: Writes poems in a pocket notebook
clues: In the margin of the observation log, next to the erased line, there's a four-line poem about the stars. The culprit writes poetry.
A sheet of poems in very fresh ink is tucked into a volume of Flammarion in the library. The culprit writes poetry.

habits.label: Flowery thermos
habits.habit: A Chinese thermos painted with roses
clues: A Chinese thermos covered in roses, still warm, stands by the telescope. The culprit never goes anywhere without one.
A thermos cup with a painted rose sits on top of the engine in the generator room. The culprit carries a Chinese thermos.

tech: The dome motor has been stopped, and the relay in the generator room switched to manual. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
The weather recorder in the lab was switched off for exactly an hour, and the paper tape isn't torn. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
late: The kettle in the dining room was boiled three times between one and three, when the whole shift is asleep. The culprit is a night owl.
The generator-room log was filled in at three in the morning in a brisk, even hand without a single slip. The culprit is a night owl.
tools: The cover of the inspection hatch in the dome was taken off, the cotter pins pulled and the bolts laid out in order. The culprit is handy with tools.
The photographic plate cabinet in the lab was opened with a screwdriver without a single scratch. The culprit is handy with tools.
quiet: The graduate student was asleep in a guest room by the stairs, where every step creaks, and heard nothing. The culprit moves silently.
Someone crossed the echoing iron floor of the dome to the telescope, and the meteorologist in the lab didn't look up. The culprit moves silently.
french: In place of the erased line in the observation log, someone has pencilled "nuit claire". The culprit knows French.
A French star atlas lies open in the library, the page with Orion folded down. The culprit knows French.
strong: The heavy dome shutter was pushed open by hand while the motor was off. The culprit is physically strong.
The professor was carried up twenty iron steps to the telescope. The culprit is physically strong.
sched: The log was erased in the twenty minutes when, by the schedule, the meteorologist reads the instruments on the roof. The culprit knows the schedule.
The generator was switched over at exactly three, the hour of the planned diesel changeover. The culprit knows the schedule.
keys: The dome door is locked, and the lock hasn't been touched. The culprit had keys.
The cabinet with the night logs in the library was opened with its own key. The culprit had keys.
safe: The safe in the library was opened without force, and the folder of funding reports is gone. The culprit knows the safe combination.
The fireproof box of old plates in the lab is open, and there isn't a scratch on the dial. The culprit knows the safe combination.
medic: The professor's mug by the telescope has a bitter residue, and sleeping pills are missing from the dining-room first-aid kit. The culprit knows about poisons.
There's a tiny, barely visible needle mark on the professor's neck. The culprit knows about poisons.
passages: The tracks in the snow avoid the main entrance and lead to the generator-room hatch, which guests don't know about. The culprit knows the service passages.
A narrow service ladder behind a bookcase leads from the library up into the dome, and the frost on it has been rubbed off. The culprit knows the service passages.
cash: The food money is missing from the quartermaster's drawer in the dining room, yet the ledger balances. The culprit had access to money.
The patron's cheque for a new spectrograph was cashed a day early. The culprit had access to money.
glasses: The rubber eyecup of the telescope has a dent, the kind a pair of glasses leaves when pressed right up to it. The culprit wears glasses.
A fogged-up lens in a thin frame lies in the snow by the stairs to the summit. The culprit wears glasses.
